annotations.title: Import products from the brand's Mercatus store

description:
[writes · `stores:manage` scope] Imports products from the brand's connected Mercatus Liber store, the same as the dashboard's product picker. Send `productGids` (gid://mercatus/Product/<id> or the bare store product id, up to 300) to add those products and import them; send none to refresh every product already imported. Runs in the background; the dashboard's cooldowns and import-set cap apply (429 import_cooldown carries retryAfterMs). `brandId` is required on an account-wide connection. Needs the explicit `stores:manage` scope plus `write`.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/stores/mercatus/import.)

brandId.description: The brand (GET /api/v2/brands). Required for an account-wide key; a brand-bound key may omit it.

productGids.description: Products to add and import: `gid://mercatus/Product/<id>` or the bare store product id. Omit to refresh the current import set.
